capabilities.description: Inspect genuine engine imports or prepare a private pinned environment.

usage.inputs: {action:"inspect"|"prepare",pythonPath?}; prepare uses existing CPython 3.12 and installs only into a private venv.
usage.outputs: {ready,pythonPath,versions,environmentDigest,reason?}; ready reflects actual imports and the validated dependency lock.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Freeze source data into a reusable immutable Qlib snapshot; perform no search or evaluation.

usage.purpose: Freeze source data into a reusable immutable Qlib snapshot; perform no search or evaluation.
usage.inputs: {requestId,source,layout,budget:{maxSeconds,maxInputBytes,maxOutputBytes}}. Declare UTC development/holdout partitions and the prediction target.
usage.outputs: {snapshotRef,snapshotId,fields,layout,rows}. Read the completed native Run output before scheduling dependent work.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Open a fixed search space or request one candidate batch; the caller decides whether to continue.

usage.purpose: Open a fixed search space or request one candidate batch; the caller decides whether to continue.
usage.inputs: Open: {action:"open",requestId,snapshotRef,need,space,profile,references,budget}. Propose: {action:"propose",requestId,searchId,limit,feedback:[{factorId,evaluationId}]}. Read: {action:"read",searchId}. Only genuine matching development evaluations may be feedback.
usage.outputs: {searchId,snapshotRef,checkpoint,attempted,exhausted,candidates}. Open/read return no candidates. Propose never computes or evaluates them; limit=0 only acknowledges feedback.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

configurationRequirements.reason: Prepare or select the verified Qlib/DEAP/Optuna environment before numerical work.

capabilities.description: Compute only the specified formulas and partition using Qlib; keep evaluation and reference selection with the caller.

usage.purpose: Compute only the specified formulas and partition using Qlib; keep evaluation and reference selection with the caller.
usage.inputs: {requestId,snapshotRef,formulas,partition,budget,diagnostics?}. diagnostics prepares explicitly requested auxiliary values. No implicit reference computation or holdout selection.
usage.outputs: {valuesRef,valuesId,snapshotId,partition,candidates}; matrices remain in immutable artifacts. Independent calls may run in parallel under host Run control.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

configurationRequirements.reason: Prepare or select the verified Qlib/DEAP/Optuna environment before numerical work.

capabilities.description: Evaluate existing immutable values and archive genuine evidence in the library; do not select strategy pool members.

usage.purpose: Evaluate existing immutable values and archive genuine evidence in the library; do not select strategy pool members.
usage.inputs: {requestId,valuesRef,profile,referenceValues,budget}. Compute any reference factors separately and pass their matching Values refs; use [] when none are required.
usage.outputs: {valuesRef,partition,evaluations,factorIds}. These are factor measurements; application backtests and final reports remain separate Agent decisions.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

configurationRequirements.reason: Prepare or select the verified Qlib/DEAP/Optuna environment before numerical work.

capabilities.description: Register user-owned formula definitions and provenance, query independently archived evidence, or add an annotation.

usage.purpose: Register user-owned formula definitions and provenance, query independently archived evidence, or add an annotation.
usage.inputs: Register: {action:"register",operationId,formula,name,hypothesis,sources:[{url,revision,license}],changes}; sources=[] for original work. Use fixed HTTPS source links without credentials; adapt selected references to supported AST operators. Registration performs no computation or evaluation. Query: {action:"query",query:{text?,evaluated?,...}}. Read: {action:"read",factorId,cursor?,limit?}. Annotate: {action:"annotate",factorId,note,operationId}. Numerical metrics cannot be submitted.
usage.outputs: Page<Factor>, {factor,evaluations:Page<Evaluation>}, or Factor. A newly registered definition has no evaluations; later genuine evaluation merges by mathematical identity and retains registrations.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Apply an explicit external strategy decision to its factor pool or attach application evidence.

usage.purpose: Apply an explicit external strategy decision to its factor pool or attach application evidence.
usage.inputs: Read: {action:"read",poolId}. Decide: {action:"decide",change:{operationId,poolId,strategyId,expectedVersion,decision,factorIds,replaces,purpose,reason,strategyVersion,applicationEvidence}}. Feedback supplies observed strategy/pool versions and refs.
usage.outputs: Pool or a fixed feedback reference. Mining never changes pool membership; the caller owns the strategy decision.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.
